description: This file defines the MyRssReader class, an Android activity that displays a list of RSS feeds and provides menu options to start/stop services, add or delete feeds, and update all feeds.

classes.name: MyRssReader
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages an RSS feed list and associated menu options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and populates the RSS list view.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the currently selected RSS list item index before potential configuration changes.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with items for starting/stopping services and managing feeds.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, can be used to enable/disable menu items dynamically.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection, displaying alerts based on the clicked item.
